newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Media seeks extension on report.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Media seeks extension on report.

text.p: Princeton Media Group Inc said on Wednesday it asked the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an extension in filing its annual report.
The company said it expects to file the report in about five days.

Princeton said it expects to report a net loss of $366,671 for full-year 1996 on revenues of $8.5 million, including one-time charges of about $1.1 million. The company's 1996 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization were a profit of $1.5 million, it said.

Princeton said it previously announced it had reached agreement with the holders of all its outstanding convertible securities to convert their holdings into common shares. The number of shares to be issued is 1.1 million, in staged increments over the next six months.
Princeton shares were trading at 4-3/8 late Wednesday, down 3/8 on the day.
